UNIVERSITY OF KENT AT CANTERBURY
INSTITUTE OF MATHEMATICS AND STATISTICS

READER/SENIOR LECTURER/LECTURER IN STATISTICS

A Reader/Senior Lecturer/Lecturer post in Statistics in the Institute of
Mathematics and Statistics at the University of Kent at Canterbury is
available from 1 September 2000 or such a date as may be arranged.


Depending on the post applied for, the successful candidate will have a
strong research record or potential in an area of statistics or applied
probability and a commitment to excellence in teaching. Preference may be
given to a person who has proven expertise in at least one application
area and an ability to take advantage of advances in computation to
produce innovative modelling.

Informal enquiries should be directed to Professor Philip Brown, Tel: +44
(0)1227-823794 or Professor Byron Morgan, Tel: +44 (0)1227-827612 (direct
lines), Fax: +44 (0)1227-827932, E-mail: Philip....@ukc.ac.uk or
B.J.T....@ukc.ac.uk

Information about the Institute of Mathematics and Statistics may also be
found on the World Wide Web: http://www.ukc.ac.uk/ims/

Depending on the level of the appointment, salary will be in the range
17,238-38,561 pounds.

Please telephone the Personnel Office for Further Particulars on
01227-827837 (24 hours) or 01227-823674 (Minicom), quoting reference
A00/39

Closing Date: 20 March 2000.

The University is committed to implementing its Equal Opportunities Policy
